title: Pixel selection
hint: Click, then drag right or left to adjust tolerance. Shift adds; Alt subtracts.
coverage: White reveals; black hides. Creating a mask keeps the original image.
eraseHint: Remove the selected area with an editable mask.
keepHint: Keep the selected area and mask everything outside it.
selectionReady: Choose Erase to remove this area or Keep to hide the rest. Your original image stays editable.
helpChoose: Select an area, then erase it or keep it with an editable mask. Original pixels stay intact.
helpOutline: The moving dashed line marks the selected area. Very detailed outlines use a simpler preview; the mask retains the exact selection.
adjacentHint: Match a connected region. Turn this off to match the color across the image.
objectHint: Left-click includes; right-click excludes. Add points to refine, or drag a rectangle around an object. Use Keep or Erase only when the preview is ready.
objectDetectHint: Find subjects automatically. Choose a result, then refine it with points.
objectError: Object selection failed. You can retry or use the magic wand.
layerViaCopyHint: Copy the selected pixels to a new layer in the same position. Without a pixel selection, duplicate the selected layers in place.
copyEmpty: The selected area contains no visible pixels to copy.
cutHint: Move selected pixels to a new layer and remove that area from the original in one undo step.
invertHint: Select everything outside the current pixel selection.
reselectHint: Restore the last deselected pixel region on its original image.
reselectEmpty: No previous pixel selection is available for this image.
forwardHint: Move selected layers one step forward without changing their position.
backwardHint: Move selected layers one step backward without changing their position.
clippingHint: Clip selected layers to the alpha silhouette of the layer below, or release their clipping. The base stays visible.
objectBoxHelp: Drag a rectangle around the subject you want to keep.
objectRefineHelp: Check the preview. Add points to correct missing or unwanted areas.
objectRefineBoxHelp: Switch to Points to refine the outline.
objectKeepHelp: Keep the subject and hide the rest.
objectOriginalHelp: Use the buttons on the preview. The original photo stays intact.
